cards.title: Everything that happened, in order
cards.text: 37 on-track passes, 21 pit stops, 7 cars that never finished, 2 safety cars.

cards.title: 11 places changed hands on track before the first lap was done
cards.text: 22 cars into the first corner on cold tyres and full tanks.
bullets: Hulkenberg gained the most by the end of it, 3 places
cards.note: Most of this is the pack sorting itself out. Some of it decides the race.

cards.title: 5 passes on this lap alone
cards.text: Only moves made on track count here, at racing speed.
bullets: 4 different drivers gained a place on this lap
cards.note: Early on, with full tanks and the order still settling.

cards.title: Antonelli starts P16. Where does he finish?
cards.text: 51 laps to make up ground from there.

cards.title: Stroll is out
cards.text: His race ends on lap 8 of 51, in an Aston Martin.
bullets: P22 at the start of lap 7
Started P22
cards.note: The timing feed records that he stopped, not why.

cards.title: Track at 45°C at the start, falling to 40°C at the flag
cards.text: Track temperature changes how much grip the tyres find and how fast they wear. No rain was recorded during the race.

cards.title: Antonelli: 9 passes
cards.text: More than anybody else out there, in a Mercedes.
bullets: P16 on the grid, P5 at the flag
cards.note: Only moves made on track count, with the car ahead at racing speed.

cards.title: Alonso is out
cards.text: His race ends on lap 21 of 51, in an Aston Martin.
bullets: P21 at the start of lap 20
Started P21
4 on-track passes before it happened
cards.note: The timing feed records that he stopped, not why.

cards.title: Lawson hit 349 km/h
cards.text: The fastest car in a straight line is often not the fastest car over a lap.
bullets: Lawson did it in a Racing Bulls car
cards.note: Top speed says as much about wing level, and about sitting in somebody's tow, as it does about the engine.

cards.title: Who has the fastest lap on the board at the flag?
cards.text: It usually lands late, when the car is light and the track has rubber all over it.
cards.reveal: Russell on lap 49, 1:44.916, in a Mercedes.

cards.title: 21 stops, and the busiest lap saw 10 of them
cards.text: Once one car stops, the cars around it have to answer.
bullets: Busiest single lap was 30, with 10 cars in under the safety car
Shortest time in the pit lane: Hulkenberg, 20.1s
Longest: Lawson, 23.6s
cards.note: Pit lane time runs from the entry line to the exit line, stop included.

cards.title: Albon is out
cards.text: His race ends on lap 30 of 51, in a Williams.
bullets: P13 at the start of lap 29
Started P12
1 on-track pass before it happened
cards.note: The timing feed records that he stopped, not why.

cards.title: Every gap on track, erased
cards.text: The field bunches up behind the safety car, and whatever anybody had built is gone.
bullets: Russell was leading when it came out
He took a stop under it, and so did Gasly, Antonelli, Norris and 14 others
Neutralised until lap 35
cards.note: A lead built over a long run was worth nothing at the restart, and whoever had fresher tyres underneath him suddenly had a race again.

cards.title: 16 lap times deleted
cards.text: The white line is the track, and the lap simply stops counting if you leave it.
bullets: Bortoleto lost 3 that way, more than anybody
cards.note: Keep doing it and it turns into a penalty.

cards.kicker: Your call on the pit wall
cards.title: Safety car with 20 laps left. You are leading. Box or stay out?
cards.text: The pack is bunched up behind you and a stop costs far less than usual, except that everybody behind can copy you and the one who does not gets the lead.
state: Wiped out by the safety car

choices.label: Box for fresh tyres
choices.sub: Grip for the restart, hand over track position

choices.label: Stay out and defend
choices.sub: Keep the lead on older tyres

outcomes.box: New rubber under a safety car is close to free, and it only works if the cars behind stay out. If they all follow you in, you have spent your lead for nothing.
outcomes.stay: You keep the lead and restart on older tyres, with a queue of fresher cars in your mirrors and no gap to hide in.

cards.reveal: Russell came in. At the flag it was P1 Russell, P2 Verstappen, P3 Hadjar.

cards.title: Hulkenberg ran one set for 32 laps
cards.text: The longest anybody stayed out on one set.
bullets: On the mediums, lap 1 to lap 32
cards.note: Every lap you stretch is a lap you do not lose in the pit lane. And every lap you stretch is a set of tyres getting slower underneath you.

cards.title: Russell had the quickest median racing lap
cards.text: No lap 1, no laps in or out of the pits, nothing behind the safety car or the VSC, and the slow outliers trimmed. It does not always match the result.

cards.title: Every gap on track, erased
cards.text: The field bunches up behind the safety car, and whatever anybody had built is gone.
bullets: Russell was leading when it came out
He stayed out while Lawson took a stop under it
Neutralised until lap 38
cards.note: A lead built over a long run was worth nothing at the restart, and whoever had fresher tyres underneath him suddenly had a race again.

cards.title: Yellow flags out 9 times
cards.text: Race control waves a yellow for anything on or near the track that should not be there.
bullets: A yellow means slow down and do not overtake in that part of the track
Track sectors 1 and 2 saw 4 each, the most of anywhere

cards.title: 4 incidents looked at
cards.text: Every one of them logged by race control during the race.
bullets: Lap 36: Norris, Gasly and Colapinto, causing a collision
1 ended in a penalty, 2 in no further action and 1 left for after the race

cards.title: Gasly is out
cards.text: His race ends on lap 36 of 51, in an Alpine.
bullets: P7 at the start of lap 35
Started P7
Race control logged an incident with Norris, Gasly and Colapinto at Turn 1 on lap 36

cards.title: Norris is out
cards.text: His race ends on lap 36 of 51, in a McLaren.
bullets: P9 at the start of lap 35
Started P5
Race control logged an incident with Norris, Gasly and Colapinto at Turn 1 on lap 36

cards.title: Lap 36: contact between Norris, Gasly and Colapinto at Turn 1. What do you give?
cards.text: Race control has flagged it and it lands on your desk. Same call the stewards had to make.

outcomes.none: You let it go. Nobody loses a place at a desk, and the driver behind spends the rest of the race on the radio.
outcomes.5: Five seconds gets added at the next stop, or to the final time if there is no stop left. Usually one position, sometimes none.
outcomes.10: Ten seconds is a real punishment and it almost always costs track position, which is why teams argue so hard about it.

cards.reveal: The stewards gave Colapinto a 10s penalty. He did not reach the flag.

cards.title: Colapinto is out
cards.text: His race ends on lap 37 of 51, in an Alpine.
bullets: P10 at the start of lap 36
Started P9
Race control logged an incident with Norris, Gasly and Colapinto at Turn 1 on lap 36

cards.title: Piastri went the other way: 10 places lost
cards.text: Qualifying promised one thing and the race delivered another.
bullets: P3 on the grid, P13 at the flag
Qualifying rewards whoever can put one lap together. A race asks for 51 of them

cards.title: One of these three does not see the chequered flag. Who?
cards.text: Nothing on the timing screens says it is coming.
cards.reveal: Bottas, on lap 50 of 51. The timing feed records that he stopped, not why.

cards.title: Antonelli: P16 on the grid, P5 at the flag
cards.text: 11 places gained.
bullets: 9 on-track passes along the way
4 cars that started ahead of him retired

cards.title: Russell: 1:44.916
cards.text: The quickest anybody went all race, in a Mercedes.
bullets: Set on lap 49 of 51, late on, where they usually land
By then the fuel is nearly gone and the car is at its lightest
It is worth no points: the bonus point for it was dropped after 2024

cards.title: Bottas is out
cards.text: His race ends on lap 50 of 51, in a Cadillac.
bullets: P16 at the start of lap 49
Started P19
3 on-track passes before it happened
cards.note: The timing feed records that he stopped, not why.

cards.title: Hulkenberg: 11 laps within a second of the car ahead
cards.text: The longest unbroken run like it in the race, from lap 41 to lap 51, at racing speed.
bullets: 4 other drivers had a run of five laps or more like it
cards.note: Following closely costs the car downforce and cooks the front tyres, so sitting there is harder than it looks.

cards.title: 1 penalty handed out
cards.text: Given by the stewards during the race.
bullets: Colapinto: a 10s penalty for causing a collision
cards.note: A time penalty is served at the next stop, or added to the final time when there is no stop left.

cards.title: Russell wins it
cards.text: P1 Russell · P2 Verstappen · P3 Hadjar.
bullets: After 51 laps, Verstappen crossed the line 0.196s behind
cards.note: Less than the time it takes to read this sentence.

cards.title: How far behind was Verstappen at the flag?
cards.text: 51 laps, 1 hour 38 minutes of racing, and it comes down to this one number.
